description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller class 'HelloController' providing several HTTP GET endpoints such as '/', '/docs', '/health', and '/api/info'. It uses annotations for routing, documentation, and response handling, returning simple messages or redirects.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for greetings, documentation, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/', returning a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/docs', redirects to Swagger UI location preserving request scheme and host.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health', returning application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/api/info', returning application information.
